title: Administrator
description:
- General administration within Supply Chain
- Previous supply chain, logistics or Operations Admin experience would be ideal
- Full time, on site, Monday to Friday (Between the hours of 8am - 5pm)

We are looking to appoint a temporary administrator, in an ongoing, week by week contract for our client in Poole.

The ideal candidate will have strong administration experience, and ideally have worked within either Logistics, Supply Chain, Purchasing or a sales administration role.

The role will be supporting a very busy internal department, so the ability to pic things up quickly, and multi task, is essential.

You will also be working with internal teams, and dealing with customers and other third parties, so strong communication skills are required.

Duties may include:
- Processing Orders: manage and process sales orders whilst ensuring accuracy on data entries and efficiency
- Raise Purchase orders in a timely and efficient manner to departmental targets using the information provided by the business systems.Ensure supply partners provide purchase order acknowledgements. Review, challenge and escalate any issues.
- Update the company systems with relevant information and communicate changes to the wider business.
- Responsible for capturing and reporting data on product and supplier commercial performance. Ensuring supplier rebates are claimed in full.
- Preparing information & reports for supplier reviews and negotiations.
- Carry out any other additional duties as required

Ideal experience / Skills:
- Previous experience in supply chain, Logistics, Warehouse operations or similar operations roles would be ideal.
- Systems confident, with experience or working with various systems
- Excel proficiency to an advanced level.
- Detail oriented - keen attended to detail to manage complex supply chain data.
- Excellent communication skills. Able to work effectively with various stakeholders, including suppliers and procurement teams.
- Extremely disciplined to ensure processes are followed.
- Organised and structured approach to work.
- Ability to prioritise and work to deadlines.
- Product and supplier knowledge & interest

If you are available immediately, and happy to do an ongoing temporary assignment on a week by week basis, please get in touch with Joy Bruce at Collaborate Recruitment.

Our client is going through a period of growth, so there may be an opportunity for this to become a permanent position, or, if you are interested, you would then have the opportunity to apply for other internal positions as they arise.
This could therefore be a great long term prospect, but would equally suit someone looking for a stop gap, or temporary position.

title: Customer Service Coordinator
company: Bennett and Game Recruitment LTD - Agency - Permanent
description:
We're working with a leading architectural glazing manufacturer known for its commitment to quality, innovation, and professional development. With a team of over 100 staff and a large, modern site in Poole featuring a breakout area and excellent onsite facilities, they deliver bespoke aluminium glazing solutions to high-end residential and commercial clients across the UK. Now employee-owned, they offer a progressive and inclusive work culture with a focus on continuous improvement and collaboration across departments.

The business is now seeking a Customer Service Coordinator to join their Customer Services team. This office-based role is key in ensuring the smooth delivery of installation projects, managing schedules, and providing first-class customer support from initial booking through to completion. It is ideal for someone organised, personable, and motivated to develop their skills within a growing and supportive environment.

Customer Service Coordinator Salary & Benefits
- Salary: 28,000 - 30,000 per annum (open to discussion DOE)
- 28 days holiday including bank holidays
- Tax-free EOT (Employee Ownership Trust) bonus
- Free gym membership
- Pension scheme
- Free onsite parking
- Professional training and development
- Office based in Poole
- Monday - Friday working hours
- Significant career progression opportunities

Customer Service Coordinator Job Overview
- Coordinate all installation projects for bespoke aluminium glazing systems
- Book installation and remedial visits with the installation team
- Manage installation team diaries to optimise travel and efficiency
- Arrange and coordinate parts required for installations and visits
- Act as the key point of contact for customers throughout their projects
- Provide updates and resolve issues in a professional and timely manner
- Support remedial works and post-installation requirements

Customer Service Coordinator Job Requirements
- Previous experience in customer service or coordination roles
- Experience in managing schedules, bookings, or team coordination desirable
- Background in construction, glazing, or home improvement not essential
- Excellent communication skills via phone and email
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects
- Solutions-focused with strong problem-solving abilities
- Attention to detail and adaptable to changing requirements
- A collaborative team player, based within commutable distance of Poole

Bennett and Game Recruitment are a multi-disciplined technical recruitment agency based in Chichester, West Sussex operating across the UK with specialist teams covering a range of industries.
We are acting as a Recruitment Agency in relation to this vacancy, and in accordance with GDPR by applying you are granting us consent to process your data, contact you about the services we offer, and submit your CV for the role you have applied for.

title: French Speaking Customer Service Administrator - 12 month FTC
description:
As a French Speaking Customer Service Administrator, you'll play a key role in coordinating and managing freight operations from Poole. Your day-to-day will involve liaising with clients, organising shipments, and ensuring smooth logistics to keep everything running seamlessly.

Client Details

An organisation within the transport and distribution industry, based in Poole.

Description
- Plan and coordinate freight shipments to ensure timely delivery.
- Communicate with clients and partners in both English and French to manage logistics requirements.
- Monitor and track shipments to ensure accuracy and resolve any issues that arise.
- Maintain and update records of shipments and related documentation.
- Liaise with internal teams to ensure smooth operations and compliance with regulations.
- Provide excellent customer service and support to clients.
- Collaborate with other departments to optimise freight processes and improve efficiency.
- Report on freight operations and suggest improvements where necessary.

Profile

A successful French Speaking Customer Service Administrator should have:
- Fluency in both French and English, with excellent communication skills in both languages.
- Previous experience in freight planning, logistics, or a related role within the transport and distribution industry.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- The ability to work effectively under pressure and meet deadlines.
- Good problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to challenges.
- Proficiency with relevant software and systems for freight planning and documentation.

Job Offer
- Salary range of £26,400 - £27,400, dependent on the level of experience.
- Fixed-term contract offering stability and a clear scope of responsibilities.
- Opportunities to work within the transport and distribution industry in Poole.
- Potential for further career development in freight planning and logistics.
- Hybrid working available once you have passed training.

title: Sales Administrator
company: Two Six Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Sales Administrator

Poole £25,000 - £28,000 Permanent

TwoSix Recruitment are recruiting for a Sales Administrator to join a small, established business in Poole.

You'll be working closely with the Sales Manager, dealing with customers, preparing quotes, processing orders and keeping the sales admin organised and up to date.

The role at a glance
- £25,000 - £28,000 depending on experience
- Friday 4pm finish
- Monday to Thursday 8.30am - 5.00pm
- Permanent, full-time role
- Full training on the products and systems
- Small team and a varied workload

This isn't a cold calling role and you won't have an individual sales target. You will, however, be speaking to customers regularly, so you need to be comfortable picking up the phone and dealing with enquiries.

You don't need experience of the company's industry or products as you'll be trained.

What you'll be doing
- Dealing with customer enquiries by phone and email
- Preparing quotes and processing sales orders
- Keeping customers updated on orders and deliveries
- Following up outstanding quotes
- Updating customer information on the CRM
- Using Excel spreadsheets to track leads and information
- Keeping sales records and documentation up to date
- Logging customer queries and complaints
- Supporting the Sales Manager with general administration
- Helping out in other areas when needed

What we're looking for

You'll ideally have experience in sales administration, sales support, customer service or order processing.

You'll need to be:
- Good with Excel and spreadsheets
- Confident speaking to customers
- Organised with good attention to detail
- Used to working with a CRM or customer database
- A good communicator
- Comfortable working in a small team
- Someone who follows things through and doesn't let things get missed

Experience preparing quotes or processing customer orders would be useful.

Interested? Apply today with your CV and Vicki Reeks will be in touch to discuss the role with you in more detail.

title: Receptionist
company: Dorset HealthCare University NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Dorset HealthCare University NHS Foundation Trust
description: We are looking to appoint a reliable and motivated receptionist to join our dedicated administration team to support the services operating from Poole Community Health Clinic - Poole CAMHS, Community Acquired Brain Injury Service, Dorset Pain Management Service and PSALT. The successful applicant will work as part of a small team, supporting clinical staff and will act as the first point of contact between patients, relatives and clinical staff, whilst maintaining confidentiality to ensure the department always runs efficiently. This is a part time post of 15 hours per week . Applicants must have excellent organisational and communication skills, be able to work under pressure yet remain calm, polite and professional at all times. You will have the ability to deal with varied administrative duties, IT systems and changing priorities. Excellent customer service skills are essential. You will be pleasant and approachable and able to manage your workload effectively. You will provide information to patients, staff, carers & relatives relating to appointments, patient care, and meetings, verbally by telephone, face to face or written in a tactful and courteous manner often requiring non-clinical advice involving careful analysis of delicate situations regarding patient care, requiring knowledge of patient confidentiality. You will liaise with members of the public in their dealings with the teams/services, some of whom may prove at times to be distressed, challenging, or aggressive in manner. You will liaise with other members of the teams to organise and deliver a safe and efficient office system to support sound patient care, consistent with good clinical governance guidelines, whilst helping the teams to achieve targets and complete timely returns of information. Applications from candidates that require current Skilled worker sponsorship to work in the UK are unfortunately ineligible to apply for this position. For the main duties and responsibilities for this role please read the attached job description and person specification. When completing your application please ensure your supporting statement reflects the criteria set out in these documents by showing how your experience and skills apply to this post. We understand that using AI can be a useful and supportive tool when completing your application. However, we have also seen an increase in the over-reliance of AI tools which is negatively impacting applications as they remove candidates individuality, and it becomes much harder to get a sense of who you are and your authentic experience. If you do use AI, it should be used to enhance your application and not to create your supporting statement in its entirety. If we suspect you have used AI to create your supporting statement and this does not match your experience, we may withdraw your application.
